qrMenu.aciklama: Publish your restaurant/café menu or product catalog: QR codes for tables, a multilingual menu, a cart and ordering via WhatsApp.
qrMenu.aciklamaYonetici: QR menus and WhatsApp catalog stores of the agency and all clients. You can set them up on a client's behalf.
qrMenu.kopyalanamadi: The link could not be copied.
qrMenu.ac: Open the menu in a new tab
qrMenu.duzenKapali: The module for this layout is turned off on your account: the store is read-only and its public page is not published.

liste.hesap: On behalf of a client (optional, email)
liste.duzenYok: Neither the QR menu nor the WhatsApp catalog module is enabled on your account.
liste.bos: No stores yet. Create your first store above.

kategori.bos: Add a category first; items are listed under categories.

urun.indirimliIpucu: Leave empty for no discount. Must be lower than the list price.
urun.alerjenIpucu: 14 allergens: the EU 1169/2011 list (also the Turkish Food Codex list).

secenek.aciklama: e.g. Size (single choice: Small / Medium / Large with a price difference) or Extras (multiple choice, min / max).

ceviri.aiKapali: AI translation is not available right now (no key configured or the daily quota is used up). You can translate manually.
ceviri.ekDilYok: Choose additional languages under Appearance first.
ceviri.tamam: Translations added; review them and save.
ceviri.magazaIpucu: The menu opens in the visitor's language; untranslated texts appear in the default language.

gorsel.ipucu: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {{mb}} MB. Resized and converted to WebP automatically.

ayar.paraIpucu: Prices are formatted for the visitor's language.
ayar.whatsappIpucu: In international format (+90…). Orders arrive at this number as WhatsApp messages.
ayar.whatsappYok: No WhatsApp number is set, so orders cannot be placed from the menu.
ayar.saatIpucu: Up to 3 ranges per day. If closing is earlier than opening, the range passes midnight (e.g. 18:00–02:00). Leave a day empty for closed.
ayar.aramaMotoruIpucu: When off (default) the page is noindex: it opens via QR and shared links but does not appear on Google.
ayar.silAciklama: The store, categories, items and coupons move to the trash (restorable from Deleted items). Personal data in orders is erased immediately.
ayar.silAciklamaYonetici: The store, categories, items and coupons move to the trash. Personal data in orders is erased immediately.
ayar.silOnay: Delete "{{ad}}"? The menu link and table QR codes will stop working.
ayar.silindi: The store was moved to the trash.
ayar.enDusukIpucu: 0 = no minimum. Not applied to pick-up and table orders.
ayar.siparisNotuIpucu: e.g. "Pay cash or card on delivery."
ayar.saklamaIpucu: Name, address and note of older orders are erased; amounts stay for statistics. Default 90 days.

siparis.saklama: Personal data is erased after {{gun}} days
siparis.bos: No orders yet. They appear here when visitors order via WhatsApp.
siparis.anonim: Personal data was erased because the retention period ended.
siparis.tesekkur: Enjoy your meal, see you again!

qr.masaAciklama: A separate QR per table: the menu opens with that table number and table orders are assigned to it automatically.

analiz.bot: Bots and link previews were not counted ({{sayi}} filtered).

ice.aciklama: CSV columns: kategori, ad, aciklama, fiyat, etiketler (optional: indirimli_fiyat, alerjenler, kalori). Separated by semicolons or commas, up to {{sayi}} rows. Missing categories are created.
